characters.name: Akira Arel
characters.role: protagonist; Red Line emergency courier and rescue-route runner
characters.surface_goal: Deliver Elias's evidence and treatment key to an independent broadcast node.
characters.inner_need: Accept that trust requires dependence on other people, not perfect control.
characters.flaw: Treats attachment as a vulnerability and silently carries every burden.
characters.infection_arc: Anosmia on day 3, facial-recognition failure on day 5 and progressive route-memory errors after day 9.
characters.season_arc: A lone protector who identifies people by threat becomes someone who identifies them by repeated acts of care.
characters.gameplay_value: Traversal, close-range defensive action, timed courier choices and unreliable navigation.
identity_anchors: two-tap pause before opening a door

characters.name: Mina Arel
characters.role: Akira's younger sister; community radio apprentice with congenital prosopagnosia
characters.surface_goal: Build a civilian identity protocol that does not depend on MNEMOS.
characters.inner_need: Stop allowing others to mistake adaptation for invulnerability.
characters.strength: Recognizes people through voice, gait, context and behavior.
characters.flaw: Hides fear behind competence and takes reckless responsibility for strangers.
characters.infection_arc: Her existing prosopagnosia grants no immunity; late infection attacks temperature control and autobiographical memory.
characters.season_arc: The person treated as impaired becomes the architect of the city's humane identity network, then must rebuild her own relationships after treatment.
characters.gameplay_value: Identity-verification tutorials, radio coordination and trust puzzles.

characters.name: Sera Veyl
characters.role: MNEMOS identity-crimes inspector; pursuer who becomes Akira's uneasy ally
characters.surface_goal: Recover the ledger and prevent mass identity fraud.
characters.inner_need: Learn that verified identity is not the same as truth or consent.
characters.flaw: Trusts systems precisely when frightened by people.
characters.infection_arc: A false identification of her own partner destroys her professional certainty.
characters.season_arc: She moves from enforcing emergency control to sacrificing her clearance so the public can audit MNEMOS.
characters.gameplay_value: Investigation, restricted-zone access and evidence-chain decisions.

characters.name: Dr. Maelle Soren
characters.role: neuroimmunologist; co-creator of LIMEN and designer of MAB-TJ
characters.surface_goal: Manufacture enough early treatment before FHD-80 reaches the brainstem phase.
characters.inner_need: Confess that her silence enabled the trial even though she opposed its final form.
characters.flaw: Uses usefulness as a substitute for accountability.
characters.season_arc: She begins by rationing truth like medicine and ends by surrendering her work, name and freedom to make treatment public.
characters.gameplay_value: Diagnosis, treatment allocation and ethically costly medical choices.

characters.name: Director Noe Varga
characters.role: director of civic continuity and principal human antagonist
characters.surface_goal: Keep Neo-Geneva functioning long enough to deploy late-stage treatment.
characters.inner_need: Admit that preserving the city has become more important to him than preserving its citizens' agency.
characters.strength: Understands infrastructure, panic and second-order consequences.
characters.flaw: Believes consent is an unaffordable luxury during catastrophe.
characters.season_arc: His defensible emergency decisions harden into permanent identity control; he loses because he refuses public choice.
characters.gameplay_value: Faction pressure, emergency decrees and morally credible opposition.

characters.name: Dr. Elias Rhen
characters.surface_goal: Move the trial ledger beyond MNEMOS custody before losing recognition and speech.
characters.inner_need: Turn private guilt into evidence others can act on.
characters.flaw: Waited for certainty while subjects were already being harmed.
characters.season_arc: His recordings change from clinical notes to intimate apologies, but he dies on day 17 and never becomes an all-knowing guide.
characters.gameplay_value: Nonlinear evidence fragments and unreliable chronology without supernatural messages.
identity_anchors: taps glass when searching for a word

relationship_core: Akira protects Mina physically; Mina teaches Akira how to recognize without faces.
Akira and Sera begin as courier and pursuer, then become mutually necessary witnesses rather than a forced romance.
Maelle and Varga share responsibility but diverge over consent, disclosure and acceptable loss.
Elias's evidence can reveal past facts but cannot solve present moral decisions.
